effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] All of your opponent's Digimon get -5000 DP for the turn.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from a security stack, delete 1 of your opponent's 8000 DP or lower Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) until the end of your turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
